description:
Cast Devout Monk by paying {W}.
When Devout Monk enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing Devout Monk
When Devout Monk dies, Enduring Renewal triggers, returning Devout Monk from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {W}.
Repeat.
